notes: 子页栈与行手势改用框架资产 aibox/ui 的 useSubpageStack / useRowGestures（删除本地 lib/shell.ts 中的页栈实现与 lib/gestures.js）；AI 动作 id 改为下划线式

localizedNotes.en: Subpage stack and row gestures now use useSubpageStack / useRowGestures from aibox/ui (local copies removed); AI action ids switched to snake_case

manifest.name: 语音备忘录
manifest.summary: 录音、转写与 AI 分析

localizedSummaries.en: Record, transcribe and analyze voice memos

actions.name: memo_list
actions.summary: Lists this app's voice recordings, newest first. Filter by a text query or favourites only. Read-only.

actions.name: memo_transcribe
actions.summary: Transcribes one recording with Apple speech recognition and returns the text. It waits for completion, so a long recording can take minutes. Already-transcribed recordings return immediately; read them with memo_transcript.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","description":"The recording id from memo_list."},"locale":{"type":"string","description":"BCP-47 locale such as en_US or zh_CN. Defaults to the configured transcription language. Pass the language actually spoken — a mismatch produces garbage."}},"required":["id"],"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: memo_transcript
actions.summary: Returns the transcript of one recording: status and the full text. Prefers the speaker-corrected version when one exists. Read-only.

actions.name: memo_summarize
actions.summary: Summarizes a recording's transcript and returns the summary text. Takes a template: general, meeting, interview, oneOnOne, lecture or podcast — each produces a different section structure (decisions and action items for meetings, strengths and concerns for interviews, and so on). Needs a completed transcript; run memo_transcribe first.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","description":"The recording id from memo_list."},"template":{"type":"string","enum":["general","meeting","interview","oneOnOne","lecture","podcast"],"description":"Summary shape; defaults to 'general'."}},"required":["id"],"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: memo_action_items
actions.summary: Extracts tasks, decisions and personal commitments from a recording's transcript, each with an owner and a due hint when the speaker actually stated one. Nothing is invented. Needs a completed transcript.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","description":"The recording id from memo_list."},"force":{"type":"boolean","description":"Re-extract instead of returning the cached result."}},"required":["id"],"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: memo_ask
actions.summary: Answers a question about one recording using only its transcript — nothing else. Use it instead of pulling the whole transcript when the user asks something specific about a long recording.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","description":"The recording id from memo_list."},"question":{"type":"string","description":"The question to answer from the transcript."}},"required":["id","question"],"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: memo_export
actions.summary: Renders one recording as structured Markdown, plain text or SRT subtitles — title, created time, duration, summary, transcript, chapters, action items and translation, whichever exist. Returns the rendered text; it does not write a file.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","description":"The recording id from memo_list."},"format":{"type":"string","enum":["markdown","text","srt"],"description":"Output format; defaults to 'markdown'."}},"required":["id"],"additionalProperties":false}
